exports.label: Potassium chloride (potash)
exports.n: Potash exports of Belarus in customs data fell from 11.6 Mt in 2020 to 3.59 Mt in 2024 (CEPII BACI). A change in the recorded origin of shipments is a plausible cause; it is not established here. Of the 11.6 Mt of potash that Belarus exported through Russia in 2025, 9% went by rail to China and the CIS countries together and the rest through Russian seaports, half of it from Bronka (Kommersant, as reported by Reform.news on 27 March 2026, https://reform.news/en/belarus-exported-11-6-million-tonnes-of-potash-fertilizers-via-russian-ports). The atlas counts Belarus's recorded potash exports to China as seaborne, through St Petersburg: the page gives no rail share for China alone, so nothing is subtracted.
exports.warn: Product weight of potassium chloride. The production table is converted to the same unit (Atlas conversion); reserves are in K2O content.
This ranks customs trade, not refinery output: countries that store, blend and re-export products may rank high, which the atlas does not measure.
